definitions.explanation: An intensifier used to emphasize the degree of an adjective or verb. Widely used in casual spoken Japanese. Originally the adverbial form of the adjective すごい, but now functions independently as an adverb.

examples.japanese: すごく⟦{楽|たの}しかった→楽しい：00817_tanoshii⟧。
⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧すごく⟦{寒|さむ}い→寒い：00664_samui⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: It's extremely cold today, isn't it.

examples.japanese: すごく⟦{頑張|がんば}った→頑張る：01222_ganbaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}なかった→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: I tried incredibly hard, but didn't get results.

notes:
The standard adverbial form of ⟦すごい→すごい：01128_sugoi⟧ (amazing/terrible), used as an intensifier meaning "very" or "extremely."

USAGE:
In casual speech, ⟦すごい→すごい：01128_sugoi⟧ is also widely used as an adverb (⟦すごい→すごい：01128_sugoi⟧⟦{楽|たの}しい→楽しい：00817_tanoshii⟧ instead of すごく⟦{楽|たの}しい→楽しい：00817_tanoshii⟧). This is grammatically nonstandard but extremely common in everyday conversation.

SIMILAR WORDS (intensifiers by register):
- ⟦めちゃくちゃ→めちゃくちゃ：05178_mechakucha⟧ / ⟦めっちゃ→めっちゃ：04748_meccha⟧: super, crazy (very casual, young speakers)
- すごく: very, extremely (casual)
- ⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧: very (neutral, standard)
- たいへん: very (slightly formal)
- ⟦{非常|ひじょう}→非常：01598_hijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: extremely (formal, written)

REGISTER:
すごく is informal and used primarily in spoken language. In formal writing, prefer ⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧ or ⟦{非常|ひじょう}→非常：01598_hijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧.
